# 維摩經義記卷第四

**ID:** T2769
**Volume:** T85
**Category:** 經集部類,敦煌寫本部類
**Original Category:** 古逸部
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T2769

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Wéimó jīng yì jì* fascicle 4 (T2769) is the fourth-fascicle fragment of an originally larger Dunhuang Vimalakīrti commentary; the other fascicles do not survive. The Taishō header cross-references No. 475 (Kumārajīva's translation). This is part of the Dunhuang fragment cluster (T2768–T2778, several of which are catalogued in this division).

**Abstract**

This fragment is one of the Dunhuang Vimalakīrti commentaries preserved at Taishō volume 85. The fragmentary state and lack of authorship attribution are typical of the corpus. The doctrinal content suggests Tang-era origin, possibly related to or distinct from [KR6i0087](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0087) (T2768) — both share the *yìjì* genre title. The Dunhuang scriptorium produced multiple Vimalakīrti commentaries through the Tang and into the Tibetan and Guīyìjūn 歸義軍 periods (mid-9th to late-10th c.).
